info.name: GlazeAudio API
info.description:
Demonstrates JWT authentication (register, login, refresh, logout, roles in the token), all 15 GlazeAudio API methods (albums → songs → reviews), user accounts, pagination, filtering, hypermedia links, the album overview, and the 400 / 401 / 403 / 404 / 409 / 422 / 201 / 204 cases.

Run the whole collection with the Runner (or `postman collection run`). It registers its own user and logs in as the seeded admin, creates an album, song and review, then deletes everything, so it can be re-run any number of times.

exec: // Unique name per run, so the collection can be re-run without 409 conflicts
pm.test("New accounts get the User role", () => pm.expect(b.user.role).to.eql("User"));
pm.test("Location header points to the new user", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Location")).to.include("/api/users/" + b.user.id));
pm.test("The role is stored inside the token", () => pm.expect(claims.role).to.eql("Admin"));

pm.test("Token has user id, name and expiry", () => { pm.expect(claims.sub).to.eql(String(b.user.id)); pm.expect(claims.name).to.eql("admin"); pm.expect(claims.exp * 1000).to.be.above(Date.now()); });

request.description: The admin account is seeded. Set adminPassword in the environment if you changed it.
Refresh tokens are single-use. Reusing one also revokes the user's other refresh tokens (theft protection); the access token stays valid until it expires.

item.name: POST login as the test user (by email)

request.description: The reuse above logged this user out everywhere, so log in again (login accepts a username or an email).

exec: pm.test("Says the token is invalid", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().title).to.eql("Invalid or expired token."));
pm.test("Returns a page of users", () => { pm.expect(b.items).to.not.be.empty; pm.expect(b).to.include.keys("page","pageSize","totalCount","totalPages","_links"); });

exec: pm.test("Explains why", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("Only admins can change roles."));
pm.test("Returns a page of seeded albums", () => { pm.expect(b.items).to.be.an("array").that.is.not.empty; pm.expect(b).to.include.keys("page","pageSize","totalCount","totalPages","_links"); });

pm.test("Has next link, no prev link", () => { pm.expect(b._links).to.have.property("next"); pm.expect(b._links).to.not.have.property("prev"); });
pm.test("Now on page 2 with a prev link", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.page).to.eql(2); pm.expect(b._links).to.have.property("prev"); });

item.name: Filter - albums by genre and year

exec: pm.test("Every album matches", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.items).to.not.be.empty; b.items.forEach(a => { pm.expect(a.genre.toLowerCase()).to.include("rock"); pm.expect(a.releaseYear).to.be.at.least(1990); }); });
pm.test("Finds the album created by this run", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().items.map(a => a.id)).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("albumId"))));

item.name: Hypermedia - follow the album's songs link

exec: pm.test("All songs are at least 300 s long", () => pm.response.json().items.forEach(s => pm.expect(s.durationSeconds).to.be.at.least(300)));

item.name: Filter - reviews by author and minimum rating

exec: pm.test("Only matching reviews", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.items).to.not.be.empty; b.items.forEach(r => { pm.expect(r.username).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("testUsername")); pm.expect(r.overallRating).to.be.at.least(4); }); });
pm.test("Lists the review with its song and album", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.items).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(b.items[0].albumTitle).to.eql("In Rainbows"); });
